ADD-03/2.2-disp.reason: ambiguous: 'Every period calculated by reference to the Proposal Due Date is adjusted accordingly.' names no clause, unlike ADD-01:2.2 which listed Volume I Clauses 5.2, 6.3, 7.1 and footnote 12 to Clause 8.5. Reading A: the same periods ADD-01:2.2 listed; Reading B: every PDD-referenced period in the RFP Documents at ADD-03, including any this Addendum amends elsewhere (Bid Bond, Proposal validity per Q18). Annotating targets would widen scope beyond the printed words; a person (Bid management) decides the targets.

ADD-03/cover/para1-disp.reason: Issue-date line 'Issued 8 November 2026': it records the Addendum's date of issue (the stage date) and amends, obliges or excepts nothing.

ADD-03/cover/para2-disp.reason: Title line 'Tender NUPA/ISTP/2026/014' under the heading 'ADDENDUM NO. 3': identifies the tender and the Addendum; amends, obliges or excepts nothing.

ADD-03/1.1-disp.reason: Recital: 'This Addendum takes precedence over Addenda Nos. 1 and 2 in accordance with Volume I Clause 3.2.' It applies the existing order of precedence, VOL-I:3.2(a) '(a) the Addenda, a later Addendum prevailing over an earlier one;', and does not amend VOL-I:3.2. A person confirms that 'takes precedence' adds nothing beyond 3.2(a).

DISP-ADD03-3.2.reason: The provision changes no volume unit: its words 'The substantive requirements of Volume II Section 6 are unchanged' leave VOL-II Section 6 (Clauses 6.1 to 6.3) as it stands at ADD-02. Its obligation 'shall be addressed in the Technical Proposal narrative' is an obligation of the addendum's own, carried by the proposed row R-ADD03-3.2 on ADD-03:3.2, not a change to any target. A person confirms this no_effect.

DISP-ADD03-4.3.reason: ambiguous: ADD-03:4.3 prints only 'Volume I Clause 1.3 is amended correspondingly.' and no old/new words. VOL-I:1.3 at ADD-02 reads 'nominal capacity one hundred and twenty thousand cubic metres per day (120,000 m³/day)'. Reading (a): both the spelled-out words and the figure are amended to correspond to the 150,000 m³/day substituted by ADD-03:4.1 (the new spelled-out words are not printed anywhere in the addendum). Reading (b): only the figure '120,000 m³/day' is substituted by '150,000 m³/day' as printed in ADD-03:4.1, leaving the words 'one hundred and twenty thousand cubic metres per day' (an internal inconsistency). No op is proposed; a person decides the reading and the exact new text.

ADD-03/Q16-disp.reason: The provision prints no change: the Authority's response is 'No. Table 2-2 is unchanged.' It contains no amending, obliging or excepting words ('shall', 'must', 'unless', 'is deleted', 'is substituted' are absent). It confirms that the design influent characteristics in Table 2-2 (VOL-II:T2-2, 'Table 2-2 — Design influent characteristics') stand as at ADD-02. An annotate/confirms op was tried and refused by the engine (C22 'not cited: [VOL-II:T2-2]') because Q16 names 'Table 2-2' without a volume; the target identification is an interpretation (S-Q16-I1) a person confirms.

ADD-03/Q18-disp.reason: The provision prints no change: the response 'One hundred and fifty (150) days from the Proposal Due Date as amended.' restates the period already in VOL-I:7.1 at ADD-02 ('Each Proposal shall remain open for acceptance for one hundred and fifty (150) days from the Proposal Due Date.'), which ADD-03:5.2 also states is unchanged ('The Proposal validity period in Clause 7.1 is unchanged.'). It contains no amending, obliging or excepting words. 'as amended' refers to the Proposal Due Date, which is amended by ADD-03:2.1 (another batch); the validity expiry follows from the date rule anchored on the Proposal Due Date, not from a change of Clause 7.1. An annotate/confirms op on VOL-I:7.1 was refused by the engine (C22 'not cited: [VOL-I:7.1]') because Q18 names no clause; the target is an interpretation (S-Q18-I1) a person confirms.
